Example.meta_description: A reference slice, available in development only.
Example.title: Example slice
Example.presentation: A worked reference for the shape of a feature: a validated form, a Server Action, a server query, and the offline write queue. It has no route in a production build. Read src/features/example/spec.md, then delete it.

ExampleForm.error_body_length: A note must be between 1 and 80 characters
ExampleForm.pending_notes: {count, plural, one {Waiting to sync: # note} other {Waiting to sync: # notes}}
ExampleForm.rejected_notes: {count, plural, one {Could not save # note} other {Could not save # notes}}

ExampleList.empty_description: Add one above. It is stored on the server, and queued in the browser when the server cannot be reached.

ExampleForecast.title: Live forecast
ExampleForecast.explanation: Fetched in the browser from a third-party API through src/lib/api. The notes above are read and written on the server instead — same page, two data paths, on purpose.
ExampleForecast.reading: {location}: {temperature}, {condition, select, clear {clear sky} cloudy {cloudy} drizzle {drizzle} fog {fog} rain {rain} snow {snow} thunderstorm {thunderstorm} other {conditions unknown}}
ExampleForecast.error_description: The weather service could not be reached.
